title: CE41017: Watershed Management
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Management of watersheds for soil/water/vegetation conservation; preparation of
land drainage schemes: types and elementary design of facilities for surface
drainage/ subsurface drainage/special drainage; types and elementary design of
water conservation and water harvesting structures for different types of
catchments; estimation of outflows from watershed outlet structures; flood
routing through channels and reservoirs; flood control through single purpose
and multipurpose reservoir operation; types and basic design of flood
forecasting and protection systems; flood magnitude quantification and flood
damage case studies; types and preliminary analysis of droughts; strategies for
drought-proofing.
